name: Kiya Nelty
source:
"I have a disease that makes me forget things easily. I have to write things down because tomorrow I'll forget them. I have to write everything down."

A boy with no relatives that lives in the Nelty Foster Home. 

He developed a memory disorder when he was a child, and since then he forgets any event that happens after a day.

He wears a wooden tag around his neck, and always writes down anything that might bother him if he forgets it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
